about.title: About TMistan
about.subtitle: Search and Explore Trademark Records in Afghanistan
about.intro: TMistan is a platform for searching and exploring trademark records published in the Official Gazette of Afghanistan.
about.intro2: It brings these published records together in one place so that they can be searched and reviewed through a simple, organized digital experience.
about.findIntro: Each record on TMistan presents the information as published, including:
find: Publication information (Official Gazette number and page)
about.purpose: TMistan was created to make trademark information published in the Official Gazette of Afghanistan easier to find. Instead of reviewing printed issues page by page, users can search across the published records by keyword and refine the results.
about.source: Every record on TMistan is based on a publication in the Official Gazette of Afghanistan and shows its source: the gazette number and the page on which it was published. Where a piece of information is not available in the published record, it is shown as N/A.
about.audienceIntro: TMistan is intended for anyone who needs to look up trademark records in Afghanistan, including:
about.tool: TMistan is a digital research and information tool. It is not a government authority, does not register trademarks and does not replace the Official Gazette or the responsible authorities. For official or legal purposes, please refer to the original publication.

help.title: Help Center
help.subtitle: How to use TMistan.
help.a1: Enter a keyword in the search box — a trademark name, applicant name, serial number (for example 1011-002), Official Gazette number (for example 1011), class number or a word from the goods and services — and press Search.
help.q2: How do I refine the results?
help.a2: After a search, filters appear above the results: Class, Gazette, Applicant, Application Type, Date Range and Advanced (mark name, serial number, goods and services, fuzzy matching). You can also sort the results and switch between the grid and table views. Use “Clear All” to remove the filters.
help.q3: How do I open a record?
help.a3: Click a result card or a row in the table. The record page shows the trademark name, serial number, applicant, address, class, goods and services, application type, publication date and the trademark image where one is available.
help.q4: What does the source information mean?
help.a4: Every record shows the Official Gazette (OG) number and the page on which it was published, for example “Source: OG 1011 — Page 3”. Information that is not available in the published record is shown as N/A.
help.a5: The serial number identifies a record within a gazette issue — “1011-002” is the second record published in Official Gazette 1011.
help.q6: Why does a record have no image?
help.a6: Images are shown where one is available for the record. Records without an image show “No image on file for this trademark”.
help.a7: “Download Record” on a record page opens your browser’s print dialog with a clean, printable version of the record. Choose “Save as PDF” to download it, or print it directly.

g.class: Class — one of the 45 Nice Classification categories of goods (1–34) and services (35–45).
g.gazette: Gazette — an issue of the Official Gazette in which trademark applications are published.
g.objection: Objection deadline — the last date on which a third party may oppose the application.
g.applicant: Applicant — the person or company that filed the trademark application.

legal.terms: TMistan reproduces trademark publications from the Official Gazette of Afghanistan for research and information purposes. The printed gazette remains the authoritative publication. Records are provided as transcribed; TMistan makes no warranty as to completeness or accuracy and accepts no liability for decisions made on the basis of this information.
legal.privacy: Public pages of TMistan do not require an account and do not collect personal data beyond standard server logs. Administrator accounts are used only to maintain the registry. No data is sold or shared with third parties.
disclaimer: TMistan is an independent research platform and a product of Masnad Law Firm. It is not the official Government trademark registry of Afghanistan and is not a substitute for official legal records and procedures.

Records are reproduced as published in the Official Gazette of Afghanistan and may differ from the printed publication through transcription. TMistan does not perform official trademark clearance, does not guarantee the availability of any trademark, and does not provide legal advice.
For legal or procedural matters, refer to the official publication and the responsible authorities, or seek professional advice.
